rows.en:
{f:Way to go|Ooh}!
That's {f:my boy|impressive}.
{f:Go make your move on her right away|I'm a little jealous, though}.
Now then, I'll divine what kind of attitude you should take when you make your move.{p}

Kokkuri-san, Kokkuri-san, please answer us.
What must {c}{f:|} do to win that person's heart?{p}

{f:The oracle says to|Whoa,} {f:express your love for her openly|it says you should confess with all your heart}.
{f:Heh heh heh|Honestly}... my, aren't you the passionate one.{p}
So, what shall I divine next?{p}

If you act warmly toward {f:her|him}, the way will open up on its own, apparently.
{f:Honestly|Gosh}, all this lovey-dovey stuff is too much for {f:me|me}.{p}
So, what shall I divine next?{p}
So, what shall I divine next?{p}

Wow.
You must be walking on air.{p}
Well then, what shall I divine next?{p}

Huh?
{f:She doesn't like you?|What's going on?}
Earlier it said things would go well.
...I get it.
{f:She|This} {f:thinks of you as her backup guy|is what Kokkuri-san really means}.
In other words, {f:you're the only one in love;|it gave a bad answer on purpose} {f:she doesn't love you at all|to put an end to your romance}.
...{f:Maybe she's after your money;|And it's telling you to go out with} {f:that kind of thing happens|a wonderful man like me}.{p}
Money troubles, huh.{p}If that's what's on your mind, does that mean you're a big spender?
Say yes
Say no

I see.
...A big spender, huh.{p}Don't you want to save up your money and buy something, or go on a trip, or take classes somewhere, or do anything like that{f:, huh|, hm}?
I do have something I want to do
I haven't really thought about it

Then you shouldn't be wasting it all.
...But anyway, shall I divine whether you'll reach that goal?
Kokkuri-san, Kokkuri-san, please answer us.
Will {c}{f:|} achieve that goal?{p}
Well then, what shall I divine next?{p}

{f:You're hopeless|That's no good}, you know.
You spend your money, you've got no goal, and then you want me to divine your money troubles?{p}

Well, {f:it can't be helped|let's give it a try}.
I'll divine whether your luck with money is good right now.
Kokkuri-san, Kokkuri-san, please answer us.
Is {c}{f:|}'s luck with money good at the moment?{p}

Hmm, good for you.
You've got the luck, so {f:why not|how about you} spend your money with a bit more planning?
All right.
Now I'll divine how you can cut down on your wasteful spending.
Kokkuri-san, Kokkuri-san, please answer us.
How can {c}{f:|} break the habit of wasting money?{p}

S, A, V, I, N, G, S...?
I see, savings.
Yes, yes, that's the surest way.
A piggy bank or a real bank, either one is fine.
If you like, I can even hold onto it for you.
First, you have to learn the joy of saving money.
So, what shall I divine next?{p}

Oh, brother...
Well, don't look so disappointed.
I'll do a different reading for you.
Come on, which one will it be?{p}

So you're not a big spender.
Does that mean you like saving money?{p}Or are you just plain broke?
Because I like saving money
I'm just plain broke

Mmm, splendid.
So you'll be rich someday.
{f:Our meeting here must be fate|I've felt fate between us since the moment we met}.
{f:Let's make this the start|From now on,} {f:of a beautiful friendship|let's stay very, very close}.
Heh heh heh...{p}

Let's see, just because you get rich doesn't mean you can relax.
Rich people make enemies easily, you see.
Let's divine that next.
Kokkuri-san, Kokkuri-san, please answer us.
Once {c}{f:|} is rich, will anyone appear to stand in the way?{p}

Hmm, I don't know quite how to put this.
Your enemy will be your family: your parents, your children, or your spouse...
Anyway, it says someone close to you.
Do you care more about work than your home life?
You'd better treasure your family.
...Well, if you keep that in mind from now on, fate might take your side a little.
So, what shall I divine next?{p}

Kokkuri-san, Kokkuri-san, please answer us.
Will {c}{f:|} get a chance to become rich in the future?{p}

It says you've got a chance.
Well, well, congratulations, congratulations.{p}
So, what shall I divine next?{p}
So this is what you want me to divine.{p}Hmm, hmm, is there a job you want to have in the future?
Nod
Don't nod

I see.
So you're already thinking hard about your future.{p}Then are you studying anything for it?
I am
Not yet

I see.
You're putting in the effort.
Then I'll see whether all that studying will pay off and you'll be able to do the job you hope for.
Kokkuri-san, Kokkuri-san, please answer us.
There's a job that {c}{f:|} wants to do.
Will {f:his|her} efforts come into bloom?{p}

It says your efforts will be rewarded.
Yes, yes.
Keep at it.
Now then, allow me to divine whether you'll succeed in that job.{p}

Just what I'd expect of you.
I knew from the start you were a {f:guy|girl} with real promise.{p}
So next, what shall I divine?{p}

Mmm-mm.
The world is a tough place.
But still, you mustn't lose the will to keep trying.
Pull yourself together; shall we try divining something else?{p}

Maybe the way you study is wrong.
Or how about choosing a different job?
...Don't lose heart, okay?
I know, is there anything else you want divined?
Come on, which one will it be?{p}

{f:Kokkuri-san, |All right, }{f:|then, }Kokkuri-san, please answer us.
Will {c}{f:|} land that dream job?{p}

Oh, a good result!
{f:Seriously,|All right,} {f:hurry up and study|I'll come tutor you one of these days}.
It says that if you put in the effort, it'll pay off someday{f:, mind you|, after all}.
Next... let's see, I'll divine whether you'll succeed in that job.
Kokkuri-san, Kokkuri-san, please answer us.
If {c}{f:|} gets that job, will it be a success?
Please tell us how it will turn out.{p}

Well, well, you're quite something.
You're going to make it big.{p}
Well then, what shall I divine next?{p}
If you don't have a job in mind yet, I'll just divine about your studies.{p}...Which do you want to hear about: your entrance exams, or the next school test?
The entrance exams
The school test

I see.
Entrance exams are on your mind after all, huh.
All right, I'll find out whether you'll get the result you want in your next entrance exams.
Kokkuri-san, Kokkuri-san, please answer us.
Will {c}{f:|} get into the first-choice school in the next entrance exams?{p}
returns: 17:88e4: RETURN - 'get into the first-choice school' reads stiffly ({c}'s first choice); accurate, left for editorial

rows.en:
Oh, perfect!
Then I'll ask about what happens after you get into your first choice.{p}

Kokkuri-san, Kokkuri-san, please answer us.
What will {c}{f:|}'s school life be like at that first-choice school?{p}

A success!
That's something to look forward to.{p}
So, what shall I divine next?

I see.
The school test right in front of you matters more to you than entrance exams.
All right then, I shall divine the results of your next midterm.
Kokkuri-san, Kokkuri-san, please answer us.
Will {c}{f:|} get good grades on the next midterm?{p}

Wow!
So you're smart?
Or are you the hard-working type?
Then next, I'll divine the results of the final exam after that, too.
Your end-of-term grade is decided by the combined score of the midterm and the final, after all.
If one goes well but the next one tanks, that's no good, right?
All right, here goes.{p}

Kokkuri-san, Kokkuri-san, please answer.
Tell us how {c}{f:|} will do on the upcoming finals.{p}

Bravo!
You're pretty good, you know.{p}
All right, what shall we read next?{p}

Let me warn you first.
You can take the answer to this question as lying further in the future than the others.
Life has its ups and downs.
You might break up with the person you're dating, gain money or lose it...
Everyday life is always changing.
Even if the other readings came out bad, if this one comes out good, all's well that ends well.
On the other hand, even if the other readings came out good, if this one's bad, it means your future will be full of hardship.{p}...Still want me to read this one?
Have it read
Not right now
All right, then I'll read it for you.{p}...Tell me, do you have a dream for the future?
I do
Not really, not yet
...Is that dream something you can make come true on your own?{p}Or is it something you can't manage alone?
I can make it come true alone
I can't make it come true alone

So your dream is one where your own effort decides everything.
All right, I'll read it for you.
Listen. Concentrate in your mind on what I'm about to say.
Picture your dream.
......
Kokkuri-san, Kokkuri-san, please answer.
Will the dream {c}{f:|} is picturing right now come true someday?{p}

...Good for you.
I don't know what your dream is, but it looks like it'll come true someday, so keep at it.{p}

It says what's holding you back is 'yourself.'
To make a dream come true, you need a strong will.
In other words, this is a battle against yourself.
Well, do your best.
So, what shall we read next?{p}

Starting a business with friends, marrying the person you love... there are all kinds of dreams, aren't there?
All right, I'll read it for you.
Listen. Concentrate in your mind on what I'm about to say.
Picture your dream.
......
Kokkuri-san, Kokkuri-san, please answer.
Will the dream {c}{f:|} is picturing right now come true someday?{p}

...Good for you.
I don't know what your dream is, but it looks like it'll come true someday, so keep at it.{p}

'Yourself,' huh?
So making a dream come true takes your own effort first of all.
If you work hard first, helpers will turn up on their own.
I'm rooting for you.
All right then, what shall we read next?{p}

Looks like you've got helpers all over the place.
Friends, lovers, neighbors...
It says all kinds of people will support you because of the kind of person you are.
Keep at it.
So, what shall we read next?{p}

{f:So you don't have a dream, but you still want to know your future|So you don't have any dream in particular}.
...Hmm.
{f:If you ask something too sloppy|If we don't ask something specific}, Kokkuri-san will get {f:angry|confused}.
{f:Could you tell me|Let me ask you} a little more clearly what you want.{p}How do you want to live your life in the future{f:, anyway|, hmm}?
I want a fun, carefree life
I want to live a turbulent life
Even an ordinary life is fine, as long as my days are stable
It's a se-cret
Oh, your life is coming up roses!{p}
All right then, what shall we read next?{p}

Ohhh, your future is assured.
Go forth and live a life for the history books.{p}
All right then, what shall we read next?{p}

Your wish will come true.
That's one kind of happiness too.{p}
All right then, what shall we read next?{p}

......
A secret? How naughty.
Well, if you don't want to tell me, fine.
In that case, you can ask Kokkuri-san yourself, directly.{p}

Kokkuri-san, Kokkuri-san, please answer.
Will the wish {c}{f:|} is about to make come true?
Now, {c}{f:|}, go ahead and say your wish.
Just mumble it under your breath so nobody else can hear.
......................................{p}

Heh heh.
The truth is, I've got ears like a bat.
I hea-ard it, I heard it!
I heard your se-cret!{p}

...Huh?
I shouldn't have been able to hear it, you say?
I heard it, all right.
You said you want to live a fun, carefree, turbulent, ordinary life, didn't you?
Huh? You didn't say that?
Maybe I misheard...
Well, at least it says it'll come true, so good for you.
Now, what shall we read next?{p}

That came out sad, didn't it?
If my chest will do, go ahead and throw yourself on it and cry.{p}
So, what'll we read next?{p}

...I see.
Then what do you want me to read?{p}

Unfortunately, it looks like you can't save money.
Whatever comes in goes right back out.
Well, don't look so disappointed.
Your luck with money is good, so you just have to make the best use of it you can.
After all, money isn't something you can take with you to the grave.
So, what shall we read next?{p}

Nice, looks like no enemies will turn up for you.
You must be awfully well-behaved.
Isn't that great?
Now you can look forward to the rest of your life, right?
Wow, seeing you this happy makes me happy too.{p}
So, what shall I divine next?{p}

Looks like you're going to be betrayed by your subordinates.
I don't know what you'll be doing in the future, but if you don't learn to judge people, this is what happens{f:, you see|, that's all}.
Got it?
So, what shall we read next?{p}
Kazama's woman trouble
Kazama's money trouble
Kazama's studies or work
Kazama's future
Stop now

What?
You're saying I can't send Kokkuri-san home when you haven't even seen Kokkuri-san yet?
...You mean you can't see Kokkuri-san?
What are you talking about?
You can see, can't you?{p}
Man trouble
Money trouble
Studies or work
The future
Man trouble
Money trouble
Studies or work
The future
Stop now
